parent_objective: implement a no-training temporal command-response mismatch intervention runner

public_gates: implementation preserves actor input contract and does not mutate actor parameters
runner writes normal reset cross-fault delayed stale and action-response-mismatch variant rollouts
summary separates reset-only rows from temporal mismatch action/outcome-critical rows
result class is one of temporal_mismatch_positive temporal_action_only temporal_reset_only temporal_neutral temporal_artifact
no actor update PPO or promotion occurs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden fault labels or hidden parameters to actor observations
do not classify reset-only rows as temporal mismatch positive
do not alter the base actor checkpoint

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_temporal_history: implement delayed stale and action-response-mismatch hidden interventions
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether temporal command-response consistency produces stronger action/outcome evidence than cross-fault hidden injection
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: no-training diagnostic evidence only; no checkpoint promotion or deployed driver claim
stop_condition: stop if implementation cannot reconstruct temporal histories without rerunning scenarios
stop if results are reset-only or temporal neutral across full run
stop actor mutation unless temporal mismatch rows pass action/outcome and diversity gates
fallback_plan: if temporal_mismatch_positive, design source export and exact proof/generalization gates
if temporal_action_only, audit whether action-level temporal signal needs sharper outcome-critical scenarios or actor-head objective design
if temporal_reset_only, audit whether M713 actor-head objective should be next
if temporal_neutral, pivot to dynamics fidelity design or active probing
if temporal_artifact, repair the intervention construction before using results

hypothesis: Delayed, stale, and action-response-mismatched histories will be more diagnostic of command-response self-identification than cross-fault hidden swaps alone.
success_criteria: temporal mismatch rows are classified separately from reset-only rows
failure_criteria: implementation cannot reproduce normal history retention
implementation collapses temporal mismatch variants into reset-hidden only
decision_rule: M719 may admit source export only if temporal mismatch rows pass action/outcome and source-diversity gates. It must not admit actor update, PPO, or promotion directly.
